<color=#9d8563>Kuchiba:</color> If it's not food, the thing I'll miss the most probably isn't anything concrete.
Around dusk, when the sky has just turned red, students and office workers step out of their different lives to share the same leisurely air.
I don't share that leisure, and it's not my day off. I don't get days off. Soon, it will be nightfall, and crime will awaken, and I'll face battle after battle until one side gives in from exhaustion.
But for a single system hour just before nightfall, I can walk down this street and grab a bite to eat in peace.
So, I walk into a random restaurant. The owner looks at me and asks, "Working late again?"
Then, without even waiting for me to order, the owner puts down a bowl of noodles in front of me: the exact kind I always get.
The owner turns back around and continues telling the out-of-towners: "That's our security officer. Pretty cool, huh? But don't go bothering her. She's busy, and doesn't often get to eat in peace."
That's what I'll struggle with the most after leaving Planarcadia.
